title: 第13章 三妹闭关二姐进房第14章 需要积分
slug: 大罗邪仙苟在剑门当药师
content_zh:
星光之下，她一步踏入。
前面的金合欢树下，那个可恶的男人，脸带微笑坐在树下，品着他那可恶的悟道茶，眼神儿还瞄向另一边。
顺着他的眼神看过去，西门三丝内心的一瓶子“辣椒油”当场干翻。
那个地方，二姐盘腿而坐。
最优美的身体曲线，恰在他的视线之中。
这对大宝贝，昨日在他掌中揉捏，今日在他眼中晃悠……
度凌目光移了过来，手指抬起，竖在唇边，给她比划了一个手势。
这手势的意思很好懂：别出声，别打扰！
西门三丝深吸一口气，强行压制冲动，坐到了他的身边，目光抬起，一缕声音钻入他的识海：“度凌，昨晚的事情，你是不是过分了？”
“你说的是……”度凌的声音很轻，因为此刻的他，还不会传音入密。
“我二姐失了清白！”
“哦……”度凌轻轻一笑：“所以你今天过来，是拜访你姐夫来了？”
姐夫……
西门三丝心头怒火再也压制不住，立时就要发作。
度凌手指再抬起，再比划：“轻点，你姐正处在从道花后期入巅峰的关键节点上，若是一口气无法贯通，下一次将会大费周章。”
西门三丝眼中满是疑惑：“从后期入巅峰？她……她三个月前才刚刚到后期。”
“她身下有座阵，可以快速聚集天地元气，修行进度会快十倍！”
西门三丝目光霍然转向，盯着旁边的二姐。
她感觉到了！
感觉到了特异！

二姐头顶，气流异常！
似乎天地元气正在争先恐后地朝她身体里钻。
这是传说中，洞天福地才会出现的奇观……
“怎么会这样？”
“阵道之威，你不懂的！”度凌道。
“本姑娘不懂，你懂？”
“这不废话吗？此阵乃是我布下的，我还不懂？”度凌托起茶杯，轻轻品上一口悟道茶。
西门三丝内心翻江倒海。
但是，在二姐正在冲关的关键节点上，天大的事儿，大概也只能放下。
她目光慢慢从二姐身上收回，转向度凌这张坏坏的，痞痞的脸上，深吸气，尽量轻地发声：“看来，本姑娘的确是小瞧你了。”
“现在调整下认知，也不算太迟。”度凌轻轻一笑：“等你二姐出关了，你也可以进去试试。”
这句话，在西门三丝心中注入了某种兴奋。
但是，她还是悄悄掐灭，将已经有点歪的节奏重新扶一扶：“你这悟道茶，我二姐昨晚喝了？”
“嗯，我劝过她，她看起来很随和，但是，蛮犟，自己倒自己喝，我拦都拦不住。”
“喝了悟道茶，再进药池洗澡，真的会失控？”
“其实……怎么说呢？这种层级的失控，若是强行控制，也不是绝对控制不住的，但她压根儿就不是会控制的类型，所以……”
“所以你就占了这个大便宜？”西门三丝眼神之中，似乎有一个闪亮的爆点。
“我也是男人，很正常的男人，真心没忍住，咳……事实上，我直话直说，我也是蛮随性的……”
二姐随性，他也随性。
两个随性的人凑一块儿去了……

天啊，地啊，命啊……
西门三丝这会儿是真的没了说辞……
身后突然传来一个声音：“三妹，你来了！”
content_en:
Under the starlight, she stepped in.
Under the acacia tree in front, that hateful man was sitting under the tree with a smile on his face, sipping his hateful Enlightenment Tea and looking to the other side.
Following his gaze, Ximen Sansi's inner bottle of "chili oil" was drained on the spot.
In that place, the second sister was sitting cross-legged.
The most graceful body curves were right in his sight.
These two big treasures were kneaded in his hands yesterday, and are dangling in his eyes today...
Du Ling moved his eyes over, raised his finger to his lips, and made a gesture to her.
The meaning of this gesture is easy to understand: don’t make a sound, don’t disturb!
Ximen Sansi took a deep breath, suppressed her impulse, and sat next to him. She raised her eyes and heard a voice penetrate into his consciousness: "Du Ling, what happened last night, did you go too far?"
"What you're talking about is..." Du Ling's voice was very soft, because at this moment, he couldn't transmit sounds into the secret.
"My second sister has lost her innocence!"
"Oh..." Du Ling smiled softly: "So you came here today to visit your brother-in-law?"
Brother-in-law...
The anger in Ximen Sansi's heart could no longer be suppressed and was about to explode.
Du Ling raised his finger again and gestured: "Be gentle, your sister is at a critical point from the late stage of Daohua to the peak. If she can't get through it in one breath, she will spend a lot of time next time."
Ximen Sansi's eyes were full of doubts: "From the late stage to the peak? She...she just reached the late stage three months ago."
"There is a formation under her body that can quickly gather the vitality of heaven and earth, and the progress of her practice will be ten times faster!"
Ximen Sansi's eyes suddenly turned and stared at the second sister next to him.
She felt it!
I feel special!
The airflow above the second sister's head is abnormal!
It seemed that the vitality of heaven and earth was scrambling to penetrate into her body.
This is a legendary spectacle that only appears in the Cave Heaven Paradise...
"How could this happen?"
"You don't understand the power of the formation!" Du Ling said.
"This girl doesn't understand, do you understand?"
"Isn't this nonsense? I set up this formation, and I still don't understand?" Du Ling held up the tea cup and took a sip of the enlightenment tea.
Ximen Sansi was overwhelmed with emotion.
However, at the critical juncture when the second sister is in the process of passing the test, she probably has to let go of such a big thing.
She slowly withdrew her eyes from the second sister and turned to Du Ling's naughty and naughty face. She took a deep breath and said as softly as possible: "It seems that this girl has indeed underestimated you."
"It's not too late to adjust your cognition now." Du Ling smiled softly: "When your second sister comes out of seclusion, you can also go in and try."
This sentence injected some excitement into Ximen Sansi's heart.
However, she still quietly snuffed it out and straightened the already a little crooked rhythm: "Did my second sister drink your Enlightenment Tea last night?"
"Well, I tried to persuade her. She seems to be very easy-going, but she is very stubborn. She pours and drinks by herself. I can't stop her."
"After drinking the Enlightenment Tea and then taking a bath in the medicine pool, will I really lose control?"
"Actually... how should I put it? This level of loss of control is not absolutely uncontrollable if it is controlled by force, but she is not the type to control at all, so..."
"So you took advantage of this?" There seemed to be a shining point in Ximen's eyes.
"I'm a man too, a very normal man. I really can't hold it back. Well... In fact, I'm straightforward and I'm quite casual..."
The second sister is casual, and he is also casual.
Two casual people got together...
God, earth, fate...
Ximen Sansi really has no excuses at this moment...
Suddenly a voice came from behind: "Third sister, you are here!"
